reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Picnic Water 041A
materials.text: At the picnic, everyone has a bottle with a name on it. Fill bottles at the water tap. Close the lid before carrying a bottle. Ask an adult if a lid is stuck. Take all bottles home after the picnic.

questions.prompt: You need more water. Say: ____
options: I will fill my bottle at the tap.
I will take another child’s bottle.
I will wait without filling it.
questions.explanation: A指定水龙头补自己的水；B拿他人瓶不确认归属；C一直不装水不解决需要补水。

questions.prompt: You cannot open your lid. Say: ____
options: I will leave my bottle unopened.
Please help me open this lid.
I will throw the bottle away.
questions.explanation: B按材料请成人帮开卡盖；A不打开无法补水；C丢瓶不是要求处理办法。

questions.prompt: Your bottle is full. Say: ____
options: I will leave the lid open.
I will pour it on the table.
I will close the lid before carrying it.
questions.explanation: C提瓶前盖好；A开盖、B倒桌均不合流程。

questions.prompt: Two bottles look the same. Ask: ____
options: Which one has my name on it?
Which one has the most water?
Which one is nearest the door?
questions.explanation: A依姓名确认自己的瓶；B水量、C离门距离不能按给定标识识别归属。

questions.prompt: The picnic is over. Say: ____
options: I will leave my bottle in the grass.
I will put it under the picnic table.
I will take my bottle home.
questions.explanation: C结束自己瓶带回；A草地、B桌下均是遗留现场。

materials.title: Card Message 041B
materials.text: Make a card for a sick friend. Write a kind message inside. Draw on the front. Let the glue dry before closing the card. Put the card in an envelope. Give it to Ms Hall to post.

questions.prompt: You want to write inside. Say: ____
options: I will draw only on the front.
I will write a kind message.
I will leave the inside blank.
questions.explanation: B内页写友善信息；A仅画外面、C内页留白均不完成想写内页的任务。

questions.prompt: The glue is still wet. Say: ____
options: I will wait for it to dry.
I will close the card now.
I will put it in water.
questions.explanation: A胶干后合；B立即合、C泡水不合顺序。

questions.prompt: Your card is ready. Ask: ____
options: May I leave it without an envelope?
May I put it on the art shelf?
questions.explanation: C索取信封装待寄卡；A不装信封、B留架均不完成邮寄准备。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where to draw. Say: ____
options: On the front of the card.
questions.explanation: B正面作画；A只画信封、C只画内页不合指定位置。

questions.prompt: You want Ms Hall to post the card. Say: ____
options: I will leave the card on my desk.
I will keep it in my bag.
Please post this card for us.
questions.explanation: C明确请求Ms Hall代寄；A留桌、B收自己包均不表达邮寄请求。

materials.title: Snow Model 041C
materials.text: Eva makes a snowman model indoors. She uses three cotton balls. The biggest ball is at the bottom. The hat is black paper. Eva uses two buttons for eyes. She puts the model on a shelf beside her bed. It does not go in the fridge.

questions.prompt: Eva makes the model outdoors.
questions.explanation: B False，indoors明确室内；A True换成室外。

questions.prompt: There are three cotton balls.
questions.explanation: A True对应三团棉球；B False否定数量。

questions.prompt: The biggest ball is at the top.
questions.explanation: B False，最大在底部；A True颠倒上下。

questions.prompt: The eyes are made from buttons.
questions.explanation: A True对应纽扣眼睛；B False否定材质。

questions.prompt: Eva puts the model in the fridge.
questions.explanation: B False，床边架上且明确不入冰箱；A True与否定原句冲突。

materials.title: Field Answers 041D
materials.text: Choose the best reply to each question before games.

questions.prompt: Which team are you on?
questions.explanation: A回答队伍；B时间、C地点非which team。

questions.prompt: Where shall we put our bags?
questions.explanation: C回答放包位置；A重量、B归属不答where。

questions.prompt: Who has the ball?
questions.explanation: B回答持球人；A形状、C数量非who。

questions.prompt: Are you ready to start?
questions.explanation: A回应准备情况；B跳绳长度、C鞋色不答是否准备。

questions.prompt: Can I have a drink first?
questions.explanation: B回应先喝水许可；A球色、C人数无关。

materials.title: Tool Return Board 041E
materials.text: The craft room has a tool board. Each tool hangs over a drawing of its shape. Scissors go on the left, rulers in the middle and brushes on the right. After a lesson, pupils check for empty drawings. An empty drawing means a tool has not been returned. Tell the teacher if you cannot find it. Do not borrow a tool from another classroom to fill the gap.

questions.prompt: Where do rulers belong?
questions.explanation: B尺在中间；A是画笔侧；C是剪刀侧。

questions.prompt: What does an empty drawing show?
options: A tool has not come back.
The board needs a new colour.
questions.explanation: A轮廓空代表未还；B颜色、C开课时间不由缺口表示。

questions.prompt: What should pupils do if a tool cannot be found?
questions.explanation: C报告老师；A藏板、B暗借均不合处理要求。

questions.prompt: Why are shapes drawn on the board?
questions.explanation: A按形状归位可发现空缺；B窗数、C盖名字均非功能。

questions.prompt: May a pupil use another room’s tool to hide a gap?
options: No, the notice says not to.
questions.explanation: B明示禁止；A随意可借、C蓝色例外均不存在。

units.title: 舞蹈排练的鞋子和分组

materials.title: Dance Practice 041F
materials.text: Dance practice is on Tuesday in the hall. Wear trainers, not school shoes. New dancers practise the first part with Ms Green. Other dancers practise the ending with Mr Long. Everyone meets at the centre of the hall for the final ten minutes. Bring water, but leave food outside.

questions.prompt: Practice takes place in the hall on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: A True时间地点一致；B False否定安排。

questions.prompt: Dancers should wear school shoes.
questions.explanation: B False，穿运动鞋而非校鞋；A True与明示要求冲突。

questions.prompt: New dancers practise the ending with Mr Long.
questions.explanation: B False，新人随Ms Green练开头；A True混淆分组。

questions.prompt: All dancers join together for the last ten minutes.
questions.explanation: A True对应everyone最后十分钟会合；B False否定共同环节。

questions.prompt: Food should be left outside.
questions.explanation: A True与leave food outside一致；B False否定物品要求。

materials.title: Map Key Problem 041G
materials.text: The school made a map for a garden festival. A blue circle meant drinking water, while a blue square meant the first-aid desk. During a test, several pupils mixed the symbols up because the shapes looked similar when printed small. Changing only the colours would not help visitors who could not easily tell the colours apart. The designers added a tap picture and a cross, and printed a short label beside each symbol. They tested the revised map at its actual printed size before making copies.

questions.prompt: Why did pupils confuse the first symbols?
questions.explanation: C小尺寸下形状相似；A倒印、B标签长均非问题描述。

questions.prompt: What did the blue square mean?
questions.explanation: A急救桌；B是圆形；C出口非此符号。

questions.prompt: Why was changing only colours insufficient?
options: Some visitors might not distinguish colours easily.
Blue ink was the only ink allowed.
questions.explanation: B考虑辨色困难；A无打印机、C限定蓝墨无依据。

questions.prompt: What was added beside each new symbol?
questions.explanation: B短文字标签；A照片、C价目均非新增内容。

questions.prompt: How did the designers test the revised map?
options: At the size people would receive.
questions.explanation: A按实际印刷尺寸；B仅巨屏、C无符号不合测试。

materials.title: Club Delivery 041H
materials.text: Delivery note: Clay club materials go to Room 3 on Mondays. Painting club materials usually go to Room 5 on Wednesdays. This Wednesday only, painting club will use Room 7 because Room 5 is being repaired. Put brushes in the cupboard, but leave paper flat on the large table. Deliveries must arrive before 2:00; clubs start at 2:30.

questions.prompt: Clay club receives materials on Mondays.
questions.explanation: A True对应粘土社周一；B False否定日期。

questions.prompt: Painting club will use Room 5 this Wednesday.
questions.explanation: B False，本周改7；A True把通常地点当例外日期地点。

questions.prompt: The painting club’s room change lasts every Wednesday forever.
questions.explanation: B False，this Wednesday only限本次；A True扩大期限。

questions.prompt: Paper should lie flat on the large table.
questions.explanation: A True对应纸张放置；B False否定要求。

questions.prompt: Materials may arrive at 2:30 because that is when clubs start.
questions.explanation: B False，配送必须2点前；A True混淆到货截止与开课时间。

units.title: 博物馆触摸模型的反馈

materials.title: Museum Letter 041I
materials.text:
Dear Cora,
I helped at the local museum’s trial yesterday. Visitors could touch models of three old tools, but the original tools stayed in locked cases. The models were larger than the originals so that details could be felt more easily. At first we gave a long spoken explanation before letting people touch anything. Several visitors said it was hard to remember every detail. We changed to short explanations while each model was being handled. Most visitors preferred this. We have not replaced the written labels; those are still useful to people who want to read quietly.
Best,
Jonah

questions.prompt: Visitors handled the original tools during the trial.
questions.explanation: B False，摸模型，原件锁柜；A True混淆对象。

questions.prompt: The models were larger to make details easier to feel.
questions.explanation: A True大小变化目的明确；B False否定原因。

questions.prompt: The first explanation was given before visitors touched a model.
questions.explanation: A True对应before letting；B False否定顺序。

questions.prompt: Most visitors preferred the shorter explanations given during handling.
questions.explanation: A True反馈明确；B False否定改法偏好。

questions.prompt: The museum removed all written labels.
questions.explanation: B False，未替换仍有用；A True与标签保留冲突。

units.title: 同伴缺席时调整共同任务

materials.title: Schedule Negotiation 041J
materials.text: Your group must finish a poster by Friday. One member will be absent on Thursday. Choose the response that helps organise the shared work.

questions.prompt: The absent member asks how to help beforehand. Say: ____
options: You could check the facts on Wednesday and share your notes.
You must attend on Thursday anyway.
We will remove your name immediately.
questions.explanation: A提前分配可做事实核对；B无视缺席、C立即除名不支持共同任务。

questions.prompt: You want to know everyone’s available time. Ask: ____
options: When can each of us work on the poster?
questions.explanation: B收集可用时间；A颜色长度、C鞋新旧无关排期。

questions.prompt: Two tasks depend on the same unfinished map. Say: ____
options: We should print before the map is ready.
We should forget the map completely.
Let us finish and check the map before starting those tasks.
questions.explanation: C先完成依赖项；A提前印、B弃图不解决共同依赖。

questions.prompt: A teammate cannot finish an assigned section. Reply: ____
options: Tell us what remains so we can share the work.
Say it is done even if it is not.
questions.explanation: A明确剩余再分担；B隐瞒、C假称完成妨碍协作。

questions.prompt: You want to confirm the plan. Say: ____
options: The poster must be the biggest ever.
We should all choose different deadlines.
So we will check facts Wednesday, assemble Thursday and review Friday. Is that right?
questions.explanation: C具体复述时间表确认；A夸大尺寸、B不同截止不确认共同计划。

materials.title: Lost Cap 041K
materials.text: A red cap is on the lost-property table. To collect it, tell the helper your name and describe the cap. Do not take things for a friend. Ask the friend to come to the table. Leave unclaimed things where they are.

questions.prompt: The cap is yours. Say: ____
options: My name is Amy. My cap is red with a white star.
My friend has a lunch box.
questions.explanation: B给姓名和具体描述供核认；A喜欢红色不证明物品；C饭盒无关。

questions.prompt: A friend asks you to collect his cap. Say: ____
options: You need to come to the table yourself.
questions.explanation: A本人来认领符合规则；B乱拿、C藏帽违背流程。

questions.prompt: You are not sure whether the cap is yours. Ask: ____
options: May I take the scarf instead?
May I look at the cap with you?
questions.explanation: C不确定归属先请助手共同查看；A领所有帽、B改拿围巾均不核对自己的帽。

questions.prompt: An unclaimed scarf is on the table. Say: ____
options: I will give it to my friend.
I will put it in my bag.
questions.explanation: B未认领物原地留；A转送、C私拿不合规定。

questions.prompt: The helper asks for your name. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C回答姓名；A桌大、B帽色非姓名信息。

materials.title: Sand Tray Tools 041L
materials.text: At the sand tray, use the little shovel to fill a bucket. Use the sieve to find smooth stones. Keep sand inside the tray. Put stones in the stone bowl, then return tools to the basket. Wash your hands after playing.

questions.prompt: You want to fill a bucket. Say: ____
options: I will use the little shovel.
I will use my lunch spoon.
I will tip the whole tray into the bucket.
questions.explanation: A指定小铲装桶；B午餐勺不是活动工具；C倾倒全盘不按小铲使用要求。

questions.prompt: You want to find smooth stones. Ask: ____
options: May I empty sand on the floor?
May I take all the sand home?
questions.explanation: B借筛找石；A倒地、C全带走违背盘内玩沙。

questions.prompt: Some sand is near the edge. Say: ____
options: Let us blow it onto the floor.
Let us put it in our shoes.
Let us keep it inside the tray.
questions.explanation: C保持盘内；A地上、B鞋中均不合范围。

questions.prompt: You finish finding stones. Say: ____
options: I will put the stones in the bowl.
I will hide the tools in the sand.
I will put the stones back in the sand.
questions.explanation: A所获石入石碗；B工具应还篮不藏沙；C石回沙不合分类收纳。

questions.prompt: You finish playing. Say: ____
options: I will take the tray outside.
I will leave the tools in the tray.
I will return the tools and wash my hands.
questions.explanation: C工具回篮并洗手；A搬沙盘、B工具留沙盘均不完成指定收尾。

units.title: 纸包裹与没用上的绳子

materials.title: Parcel String 041M
materials.text: Theo wraps a gift for his cousin. The gift is a small book. He uses yellow paper and a purple ribbon. A piece of string is on the table, but he does not use it. His cousin’s name goes on a white label. Theo puts the parcel in a bag beside the sofa.

questions.prompt: The gift is a small book.
questions.explanation: A True礼物明确为小书；B False否定原句。

questions.prompt: Theo uses purple paper.
questions.explanation: B False，纸黄，紫色是丝带；A True串材质颜色。

questions.prompt: Theo ties the parcel with string.
questions.explanation: B False，绳虽在桌上但未使用；A True混淆存在与使用。

questions.prompt: The label has his cousin’s name.
questions.explanation: A True姓名对应收礼表亲；B False否定标签内容。

questions.prompt: The parcel is in a bag beside the sofa.
questions.explanation: A True收纳位置明确；B False否定地点。

materials.title: Class Bell 041N
materials.text: Our class has a small hand bell. One ring means stop and look at the teacher. Two rings mean tidy your desk. Today we hear two rings after painting. We put brushes in a pot and paper on the drying shelf. Then we sit on the carpet. We do not go outside yet.

questions.prompt: One ring means tidy your desk.
questions.explanation: B False，一声停看老师，两声收桌；A True混淆信号。

questions.prompt: The class hears two rings after painting.
questions.explanation: A True对应今天的时间与铃声；B False否定事件。

questions.prompt: Brushes go in a pot.
questions.explanation: A True对应刷具收纳；B False否定位置。

questions.prompt: The pupils sit on their desks after tidying.
questions.explanation: B False，坐地毯；A True换错地点。

questions.prompt: The pupils go outside at the end of the passage.
questions.explanation: B False，明确暂不外出；A True违背not yet。

units.title: 校服交换桌的尺码与检查

materials.title: Uniform Swap 041O
materials.text: The uniform swap is on Saturday from ten to twelve. Bring clean clothes with no holes. A helper checks every item before putting it on a size table. You may take up to three items, even if you bring only one. Shoes are not accepted. Clothes left at twelve will be given to a local charity, with the owners’ agreement.

questions.prompt: What clothes may be brought?
questions.explanation: A洁净无破洞；B泥脏、C缺袖均不合接收条件。

questions.prompt: Who checks the items?
questions.explanation: B助手检查；A婴儿、C仅司机均非指定人员。

questions.prompt: A pupil brings one suitable item. How many may they take at most?
questions.explanation: C最多三件即使只带一；A混同带入数；B超限。

questions.prompt: Which item is not accepted?
options: A clean skirt with no holes.
questions.explanation: B鞋明确不收；A、C符合清洁完整衣物。

questions.prompt: What happens to leftover clothes if owners agree?
options: They go to a local charity.
They are hidden under the tables.
questions.explanation: A同意后捐本地慈善；B烧、C藏均非处理方式。

units.title: 平板电脑充电车的顺序

materials.title: Tablet Charge 041P
materials.text: At the end of computer club, switch off each tablet. Put it in the slot with the same number as its label. Only the teacher connects the charging leads. Pupils check that no tablet is left on a desk. The cupboard stays locked overnight. The teacher unlocks it before the next club meeting.

questions.prompt: Pupils should switch off tablets before storing them.
questions.explanation: A True先关机再入槽；B False否定步骤。

questions.prompt: Any empty slot is correct for every tablet.
questions.explanation: B False，要号码一致；A True忽略编号。

questions.prompt: Pupils connect all charging leads.
questions.explanation: B False，仅老师接充电线；A True对调责任。

questions.prompt: Pupils check the desks for tablets left behind.
questions.explanation: A True对应桌面检查；B False否定任务。

questions.prompt: The cupboard remains unlocked all night.
questions.explanation: B False，夜间锁柜；A True与locked冲突。

units.title: 走廊灯光试验为何分两次

materials.title: Light Test 041Q
materials.text: The eco team wanted to know whether a brighter corridor light helped pupils read signs. In the first test, the signs were also changed to larger letters. More pupils read them correctly, but the team could not tell which change had helped. For a second test, they kept letter size the same and changed only the light. Reading improved a little. They concluded that light had some effect in their test, but the first test could not show the effect of light alone.

questions.prompt: What changed in the first test?
questions.explanation: C照明和字号同时变；A漏字号；B墙色非变量。

questions.prompt: Why was the first result hard to interpret?
questions.explanation: A两个变量同时变难归因；B无人阅读、C撤标均与测试内容冲突。

questions.prompt: What stayed the same in the second test?
options: The number on every classroom door only.
The brighter light from the first test in all conditions.
questions.explanation: B控制字号只改灯光；A非所述控制；C灯光正是变项。

questions.prompt: What happened in the second test?
questions.explanation: C有小幅改善；A完全不能、B大幅变差均反结果。

questions.prompt: Which conclusion matches the evidence?
options: The first test proved light alone caused all improvement.
Light had some effect in the second test.
questions.explanation: B范围匹配第二试验；A忽略混杂；C未有证据否定大字全部价值。

materials.title: Market Return Note 041R
materials.text: Basket loan notice: Borrow a shopping basket for a £2 deposit. Return it to the same stall before the market closes at 4:00 to get the full deposit back. If you cannot return today, keep the basket safe and bring it next Saturday; the deposit can still be returned then. Do not leave baskets at the bus stop. Damaged baskets should be shown to the stall helper.

questions.prompt: Borrowing requires a two-pound deposit.
questions.explanation: A True押金两镑；B False否定借用条件。

questions.prompt: A basket returned next Saturday can never receive a deposit refund.
questions.explanation: B False，明确下周六仍可退；A True把今天期限误作永久取消。

questions.prompt: Baskets should be left at the bus stop.
questions.explanation: B False，明确do not；A True违反归还地点。

questions.prompt: A damaged basket should be shown to the helper.
questions.explanation: A True对应损坏处理；B False否定求助方式。

questions.prompt: The market closes at four.
questions.explanation: A True对应4:00；B False否定营业截止。

units.title: 展览准备中的五种词形

materials.title: Museum Form 041S
materials.text:
Complete each gap with the correct form of the word in brackets. Use one word per gap. For Gap 5, use the conventional adverb ending in -ly.
1. The guide checked exactly three ___ (shelf) before the tour.
2. Last Tuesday, the visitors ___ (choose) the quieter route.
3. This model is ___ (heavy) than the paper one.
4. Listen! The helpers are ___ (move) a table.
5. The guide explained the route ___ (clear; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: write the correct form of SHELF.
questions.explanation: exactly three直接限定复数；shelf的常规复数为shelves，shelf单数不合数量，shelfs为错误拼写；未列形式交复核。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: write the correct form of CHOOSE.
questions.explanation: Last Tuesday要求简单过去时chose；choose原形、chooses现在三单、chosen过去分词不能在此独立作限定过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: write the correct form of HEAVY.
questions.explanation: than明确两者比较，heavy变y为i加er得heavier；heavy原级与heaviest最高级不合此结构。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: write the correct form of MOVE.
questions.explanation: Listen及are后接现在分词moving，去不发音e加ing；move、moves、moved不组成此处现在进行时。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from CLEAR.
questions.explanation: 题面明确要求常规-ly副词，clearly合要求；clear、clearer、clearest均不以-ly结尾，按本题任务约束排除，不泛称其他语境无效。

units.title: 修理日志中的词形线索

materials.title: Repair Form 041T
materials.text:
Complete the five gaps with forms of the bracketed words. Use one word for each gap. Gap 5 explicitly asks for the conventional adverb ending in -ly.
1. Exactly two ___ (knife) were kept in the locked tool box.
2. Yesterday the engineer ___ (write) a short repair note.
3. The new handle is ___ (wide) than the old one.
4. At the moment, the pupils are ___ (copy) the safety rule.
5. The engineer checked the lock ___ (careful; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: write the correct form of KNIFE.
questions.explanation: Exactly two直接要求名词复数knives；knife单数、knifes作为此名词的错误复数拼写均不合句法。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: write the correct form of WRITE.
questions.explanation: Yesterday指过去，独立限定谓语wrote；write原形、writes现在三单、written分词不符合本句结构。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: write the correct form of WIDE.
